name: perp_template_pipe_belt_bridge
notes: G1 (offpath campaign, #675): a STATIC UNIT PIN of the perpendicular-template rung's internal pipe×belt logic — NOT a production-reachability probe. Production's dispatch filters pipe specs out of junction seeding entirely (ghost_router's keys_at_tile: pipes participate as forbidden tiles only, and SAT bypasses them as obstacles), so a live pipe×belt crossing reaches the solver as ONE belt spec and the rung's 2-spec admission predicate refuses it; this fixture feeds the pipe spec directly via initial_specs, a state the production caller cannot currently produce (#687 round 3). Within that scope: pipe items are conflict-gate-exempt, so the strategies run on the single-tile iteration, the admission predicate (1 tile, 2 specs, perpendicular) passes, and bridge_belt_over_pipe answers — a UG pair carries the belt under the pipe, nothing stamped on the pipe tile. Why keep it: it pins several hundred otherwise-untested lines (the rung + bridge_belt_over_pipe) and the spec_kinds replay plumbing, and it is the ready-made regression lock if dispatch ever re-admits pipe specs. solved_by pins attribution; required_entities + max_cost pin the UG-pair shape and cost — complementary pins (a cheaper fallback flips solved_by while shape pins still pass, and vice versa). Hand-authored by necessity: the capture workflow can never emit a pipe initial_spec (see README).
